jellyfish_bloom.title: The Great Jellyfish Bloom
jellyfish_bloom.story: A glittering cloud of moon jellies drifted into the kelp beds overnight. They're beautiful. They're also stinging every farmer who tries to harvest.
jellyfish_bloom.means: Kelp costs half again as much for the rest of this season.

beached_whale.title: A Whale Comes to Rest
beached_whale.story: A gentle old whale settled on the outer reef, and the whole city is feasting on the shoals that followed it. Nobody is buying kelp this week.
beached_whale.means: Kelp is 40% cheaper for the rest of this season. A good time to fill your cellar.

crab_raid.title: The Crab Raid
crab_raid.story: An army of giant spider crabs marched through the granaries at the turn of the tide, snipping every kelp bundle they could reach.
crab_raid.means: Kelp costs 35% more for the rest of this season.

glowing_tide.title: The Glowing Tide
glowing_tide.story: Plankton lit the canals blue, and the kelp beds grew twice as fast in the light. The farmers can't harvest it quickly enough.
glowing_tide.means: Kelp is 25% cheaper for the rest of this season.

pearl_strike.title: The Pearl Divers Strike
pearl_strike.story: The divers have put down their baskets until the Council fixes the cracked air-bells. No new pearls are coming up.
pearl_strike.means: Pearls cost 25% more for the rest of this season. Good news if you already hold some.

counterfeit_pearls.title: Counterfeit Pearls
counterfeit_pearls.story: Someone has been passing off painted fish-eyes as pearls. Now every buyer squints at every pearl, and nobody wants to pay full price.
counterfeit_pearls.means: Pearls sell for 20% less for the rest of this season.

diving_bell_tourists.title: Tourists in Diving Bells
diving_bell_tourists.story: A party of surface nobles came down in brass diving bells, gawping at everything and buying pearls as souvenirs.
diving_bell_tourists.means: Pearls cost 20% more and kelp 10% more for the rest of this season.

kraken_sighting.title: A Kraken in the Shipping Lanes
kraken_sighting.story: A tentacle as thick as a temple column rose beside a Leviathan Line ship. Nobody was hurt, but the captains are nervous and the investors more so.
kraken_sighting.means: Leviathan Line shares fell 15%, and storms are likelier for this season's voyages.

royal_contract.title: A Royal Contract
royal_contract.story: The Queen of the Coral Isles signed a year's charter with the Leviathan Line. Dax has been grinning since breakfast.

new_trade_route.title: Oro's Daughter Finds a New Route
new_trade_route.story: Captain Oro's youngest charted a sheltered current around the Shark Teeth. Shorter voyages, safer cargo.

deepcoral_map.title: A Treasure Map Turns Up
deepcoral_map.story: Deepcoral Salvage bought a "genuine" treasure map from a stranger at the Drowned Bell. The whole Exchange is suddenly excited about salvage.
deepcoral_map.means: Deepcoral shares jumped 50%. The map may or may not be real.

current_reversal.title: The Current Runs Backwards
current_reversal.story: For one strange day the great current ran the wrong way. Ships turned back, cargo was late, and the Exchange panicked.
current_reversal.means: Every shipping house's shares fell 10%. A panic can be a chance to buy.

seahorse_derby.title: The Seahorse Derby
seahorse_derby.story: The whole city turned out for the derby. Winners showered pearls on their jockeys, and Oro's crew bet a season's wages on the slowest seahorse in the race.
seahorse_derby.means: Pearls cost 15% more this season, and Oro & Daughters shares slipped 5%.

eel_blackout.title: The Eel Blackout
eel_blackout.story: The electric eels that light the Grand Market have gone on strike. Stalls are trading by lantern, slowly and grumpily.
eel_blackout.means: Kelp costs 20% more and pearls sell for 10% less this season.

kelp_blight_scare.title: Blight in the Kelp Beds
kelp_blight_scare.means: Kelp costs more for the rest of this season. If your cellar is full, you're fine.

storm_warning.title: Storm Warning
storm_warning.means: This season's voyages are more likely to fail. Shares in steady houses are safer.

fraud_charge.title: A Charge You Don't Recognize
fraud_charge.means: Dispute it now; it's free. A charge you don't dispute this season is gone for good.

pickpocket.title: Pickpocketed
pickpocket.means: Thieves take Purse coin. Coin in the Vault is safe.

roof_leak.title: The Roof Leaks
roof_leak.means: Surprise costs come out of your Purse, then your Vault, then your card. Savings soften the blow.

surface_boom.title: Boom on the Surface
surface_boom.means: Silk and Silkwind are riding high this season.

tavern_rumor.title: Tavern Talk
tavern_rumor.means: Rumors are right more often than not, but not always. The Herald's word is the only sure thing.

lucky_salvage.title: Lucky Salvage
lucky_salvage.means: Found coin goes straight into your Purse.

grins_offer.title: Grin Has an Offer
grins_offer.means: Grin charges half again every season. 100◈ today is 150◈ next season.

pearl_exchange.title: The Pearl Exchange
pearl_exchange.means: A "guaranteed" 40% a season. Think about who could possibly pay that.

council_rate_change.title: The Council Moves the Vault Rate
council_rate_change.means: Your Vault now earns a different rate each season.
